scenes.text: Kabhi notice kiya Newcastle aur Everton ke match ke dauran stadium ki chanting aapke exam stress aur phone‑distractions ko kaise kam kar sakti hai?
scenes.text_en: Have you ever noticed how stadium chanting during a Newcastle vs Everton match can reduce your exam stress and phone distractions?

scenes.text: Main aapko batाने वाला हूँ एक simple football chant technique जो आपके study focus को double karegi, taiyar ho?
scenes.text_en: I’m about to share a simple football chant technique that can double your study focus, ready?

scenes.text: Lekin ye chant sirf focus nahi, aapke confidence ko bhi boost karega – aage dekhiye kaise!
scenes.text_en: But this chant not only improves focus, it also boosts your confidence – stay tuned to see how!

scenes.text: Research suggest shared chanting stadiums mein cortisol level kam hota hai, jo aapke tension ko naturally lower karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests that shared chanting in stadiums lowers cortisol levels, naturally reducing your tension.

scenes.text: Jab aap chant karte hue halka sa haath hilate hain, thoda movement endorphins release karta hai, mood lift hota hai.
scenes.text_en: When you chant and move your hands slightly, that light movement releases endorphins, lifting your mood.

scenes.text: Shared chants logon ko jodti hain, social connection feel karwati hain, jo motivation ko naturally boost karti hai.
scenes.text_en: Shared chants connect people, fostering social connection that naturally boosts motivation.

scenes.text: Ab main aapko ek simple 4‑beat chant dikhata hoon, jo aap exam prep ke dauran repeat kar sakte hain.
scenes.text_en: Now I’ll show you a simple 4-beat chant you can repeat during exam preparation.

scenes.text: Chant: ‘Goal, Goal, Focus, Win!’ – isse teen baar boliye, haath upar, saans lete hue, feel karein energy.
scenes.text_en: Chant: ‘Goal, Goal, Focus, Win!’ – say it three times, hands up, breathing, feel the energy.

scenes.text: Agle chapter mein aap dekhenge kaise is chant ko daily routine mein fit kar ke exam anxiety ko crush karenge.
scenes.text_en: In the next chapter you’ll see how to fit this chant into your daily routine to crush exam anxiety.

scenes.text: Hostel ki raaton mein, night duty ke baad, exam cycle ka pressure dimaag ko overload kar deta hai.
scenes.text_en: Late hostel nights and night duties make exam cycles feel overwhelming for the mind.

scenes.text: Parivaar ki expectations aur future ki chinta milke, aapki motivation ko kabhi kabhi chhupa deti hai.
scenes.text_en: Family expectations and future worries together can sometimes hide your motivation.

scenes.text: Phone ki notifications aur endless scrolling, ek choti si break bhi aapke focus ko tod deti hai.
scenes.text_en: Phone notifications and endless scrolling even a short break can break your focus.

scenes.text: Jab aapko lagta hai sab kuch ek saath aane laga hai, stress ka level dheere dheere badhta hai.
scenes.text_en: When everything seems to happen at once, stress levels gradually increase.

scenes.text: Research suggest karta hai ki shared chants, jaise Newcastle ya Everton ke, social connection badhate hain aur stress kam karte hain.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests shared chants like Newcastle or Everton increase social connection and lower stress.

scenes.text: Chanting se cortisol level kam hota hai, aur halka movement endorphins release karta hai – ye aapke mood ko uplift karta hai.
scenes.text_en: Chanting lowers cortisol and light movement releases endorphins, uplifting your mood.

scenes.text: Isliye, ek simple football chant ko daily routine mein shamil karna, aapke exam stress ko manageable bana sakta hai.
scenes.text_en: Therefore, adding a simple football chant to your daily routine can make exam stress manageable.

scenes.text: Par kya aap jaante hain ki ek specific chant aapke concentration ko 30% tak boost kar sakta hai?
scenes.text_en: But did you know a specific chant can boost your concentration by up to 30%?

scenes.text: Ek second, socho—stadium ki aawaz aapke desk par aati hai, tab aapka stress kahin gayab!
scenes.text_en: Imagine the stadium roar at your desk—your stress suddenly disappears!

scenes.text: Dosto, jab hum ek saath chant karte hain, dimaag ka stress kam hota, motivation barhta hai.
scenes.text_en: Friends, when we chant together, mental stress decreases and motivation increases.

scenes.text: Ek shared chant aapko classmate se jodta, loneliness ko kam karta, padhai mein focus badhata.
scenes.text_en: A shared chant connects you with classmates, reduces loneliness, and improves study focus.

scenes.text: Research suggest karta hai ki chanting cortisol level ko ghataata, isse tension naturally melt hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Research suggests chanting lowers cortisol levels, allowing tension to melt away naturally.

scenes.text: Jab hum chant karte hue thoda sa step ya clap karte hain, endorphins release hote hain.
scenes.text_en: When we chant with slight steps or claps, endorphins are released.

scenes.text: In combination, reduced cortisol aur badhe endorphins milke stress ko low karte, motivation ko high rakhte.
scenes.text_en: Together, lower cortisol and higher endorphins lower stress and keep motivation high.

scenes.text: Lekin ye sirf shuruat hai—agar aap chanting ko exam schedule ke saath sync karte, kya hota?
scenes.text_en: But this is just the start—if you sync chanting with your exam schedule, what happens?

scenes.text: Ab ek football chant gaao, aur usko maths problem ke rhythm mein turant badlo!
scenes.text_en: Now sing a football chant and instantly turn it into the rhythm of a math problem!

scenes.text: Toh yaad rakho, shared chanting social bond banata, stress kam karta, aur padhai ko energize karta.
scenes.text_en: Remember, shared chanting builds social bonds, lowers stress, and energizes your study sessions.

scenes.text: Aaj se ek simple chant adopt karo, aur dekho kaise tumhara exam stress dheere-dheere fade hota hai.
scenes.text_en: Start using a simple chant today and watch how your exam stress gradually fades away.

scenes.text: Chalo, aaj ka 'Stadium‑Break Timer' shuru karte hain, jo padhai aur football ka perfect combo banata hai.
scenes.text_en: Let's start today's 'Stadium‑Break Timer', a perfect combo of studying and football.

scenes.text: Pehle 30 minute focused padhai karo, phone ko Do‑Not‑Disturb mode par set karo, distractions ko door rakho.
scenes.text_en: First, study focused for 30 minutes, set your phone to Do‑Not‑Disturb, keep distractions away.

scenes.text: Ab jab timer bajega, aapko ek chhota surprise milega jo aapki energy ko boost karega, so curious?
scenes.text_en: When the timer rings, you'll get a small surprise that boosts your energy, so stay curious?

scenes.text: Ab khade ho jao, do minute tak Newcastle‑Everton chant karo, haath se clap karo, dhadkan tez hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Now stand up, chant Newcastle‑Everton for two minutes, clap your hands, and feel your heartbeat rise.

scenes.text: Ek pal ke liye, sab log apni favorite football celebration pose dikhayein, phir wapas chant pe laut aayein.
scenes.text_en: For a moment, everyone shows their favorite football celebration pose, then returns to the chant.

scenes.text: Ab phir se baith jao, wahi subject continue karo, research suggest stress kam hone se focus badhta hai.
scenes.text_en: Now sit back down, continue the same subject; research suggests lower stress improves focus.

scenes.text: Yaad rakho, shared chants cortisol kam karte hain, light movement endorphins release karta hai, motivation barhta hai.
scenes.text_en: Remember, shared chants lower cortisol, light movement releases endorphins, and motivation rises.

scenes.text: Is cycle ko har do ghante repeat karo, aise hi stress management ka simple football formula mil jayega.
scenes.text_en: Repeat this cycle every two hours; this simple football formula will manage your stress.

scenes.text: Toh shuru karo apna Stadium‑Break Timer, aur dekho kaise exam stress football chant se pighalta hai!
scenes.text_en: Start your Stadium‑Break Timer and watch exam stress melt away with football chants!

scenes.text: Chalo, sab milke 'Go Magpies! Go Magpies!' chant karte hain, haath thapthapate hue, do minute ke liye.
scenes.text_en: Let's all chant 'Go Magpies! Go Magpies!' while clapping together for a two‑minute rhythm.

scenes.text: Jab hum ek saath chant karte hain, dimaag mein cortisol kam hota hai, stress ka level naturally girta hai.
scenes.text_en: When we chant together, cortisol drops in the brain and stress levels naturally decrease.

scenes.text: Saath mein thodi movement se endorphins release hote hain, jo aapko energetic aur focused feel karwate hain.
scenes.text_en: Light movement during chanting releases endorphins, making you feel energetic and focused.

scenes.text: Ab aapko ek secret chant technique dikhane jaa rahe hain, jo aapke exam score ko boost kar sakti hai—dekhte rahiye!
scenes.text_en: Now we’ll show a secret chant technique that could boost your exam scores—stay tuned!

scenes.text: Ek second, chalo ek funny football meme dekhte hain—yeh humein yaad dilata hai ki break bhi zaroori hai!
scenes.text_en: Hold on, let's watch a funny football meme—it reminds us that taking breaks is essential.

scenes.text: Phir se 'Go Magpies!' chant shuru karo, claps ke saath, aur har break mein do minute repeat karo, energy barqarar rahegi.
scenes.text_en: Start the 'Go Magpies!' chant again with claps, and repeat it for two minutes each break to keep energy up.

scenes.text: Jab aap sab ek saath chant karte hain, motivation badhta hai aur padhai ke liye focus natural tarike se aata hai.
scenes.text_en: When you all chant together, motivation rises and natural focus for studying follows.

scenes.text: Har study session ke beech ye 2‑minute chant routine lagao, aur dekho kaise stress kam hota hai aur performance improve hoti hai.
scenes.text_en: Insert this two‑minute chant routine between study sessions and watch stress drop while performance improves.

scenes.text: Toh aaj se apni padhai mein football chant ko shamil karo, aur har exam ko confidence ke saath face karo!
scenes.text_en: Start adding football chants to your study routine and face every exam with confidence.

scenes.text: Dekho, jaise Newcastle ke fans stadium mein chant karte hain, waise hi tum exam prep mein action lo.
scenes.text_en: See, just as Newcastle fans chant in the stadium, you should take action in your exam preparation.

scenes.text: Jab hum sab milke chant karte hain, cortisol kam hota, dimag shaant hota, motivation badhta.
scenes.text_en: When we chant together, cortisol drops, the mind calms, and motivation rises.

scenes.text: Chant ke saath thoda haath thapthapana ya step lena, endorphins release karta, energy boost deta.
scenes.text_en: Adding a light hand clap or step with chanting releases endorphins, giving you an energy boost.

scenes.text: Ab ek chhota challenge—30 seconds ke liye stadium ki tarah high five karo, phir chant shuru karo!
scenes.text_en: Now a quick challenge—do high fives for 30 seconds like a stadium, then start chanting!

scenes.text: Har 30 minute ke baad chant break karo, phone DND pe rakho, repeat daily, stress ko door bhagao.
scenes.text_en: Every 30 minutes take a chant break, put phone on DND, repeat daily to push stress away.

scenes.text: Agle scene mein main batane wala hoon ek secret technique jo aapke exam scores ko double kar sakti hai!
scenes.text_en: In the next scene I’ll reveal a secret technique that could double your exam scores!

scenes.text: Yeh technique hai rhythmic chanting—har subject ke liye ek hook banaye, repeat karo, memory lock hoti.
scenes.text_en: The technique is rhythmic chanting—create a hook for each subject, repeat it, and lock memory.

scenes.text: Comment 'Chant' agar aap try karenge, aur Soft NeuroTriage ke liye link check karo, support milta!
scenes.text_en: Comment 'Chant' if you’ll try it, and check the link for Soft NeuroTriage for support!

scenes.text: Toh aaj se start karo—chant, move, repeat—aur dekho kaise exam stress aapke piche chhoot jata hai!
scenes.text_en: So start today—chant, move, repeat—and watch how exam stress falls behind you!
